note: Set A is better because it captures more distinct engineering components present in the source, specifically the HSS4X4X1/4 member, 3" standard pipe, and both 14 and 16 gauge plates, which Set B misses entirely (B misses HSS, pipe, and 14 gauge). Both sets share significant errors: both misread the '1'-0" MIN' dimension as a maximum opening size, and both misattribute the 3/4" holes to the foundation/stiffener rather than the PV attachment plate. Set B is further penalized for excessive duplication of the incorrect '1'-0" MAX' claim (5 times) and misidentifying the 3/8" plate thickness as a weld or fastener dimension multiple times.
